population_by_zip_<N>: Entity: population counts by ZIP and demographic slice; Grain: one row per zipcode + demographic bucket (minimum_age, maximum_age, gender) identified by geo_id and zipcode; Notable columns/keys/measures: geo_id, zipcode, minimum_age, maximum_age, gender, population.
us_states_area: Entity: U.S. states geographic and metadata; Grain: one row per state identified by state_geo_id/state_fips_code; Notable columns/keys/measures: state_geo_id, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state_abbreviation, state_name, region_code, division_code, legal_area_code, feature_class_code, functional_status_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, state_geom.
us_border_area: Entity: named U.S. border features/areas; Grain: one row per border feature identified by geo_id and name; Notable columns/keys/measures: name, geo_id, aff_geo_id, us_border_geom.
us_msa_area: Entity: metropolitan statistical areas (and combined statistical areas via csa_code) geographic footprints and metadata; Grain: one row per MSA/MSA-related geography identified by msa_code or geo_code; Notable columns/keys/measures: csa_code, msa_code, geo_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, status_indicator, feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, msa_geom.
us_cities_area: Entity: urban/place area geometries and metadata for cities/urban areas; Grain: one row per urban/place identified by urban_area_code or geo_code; Notable columns/keys/measures: urban_area_code, geo_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, feature_class_code, area_type, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, city_geom.
zipcode_area: Entity: ZIP code area geometry and basic place/state attributes; Grain: one row per zipcode identified by zipcode; Notable columns/keys/measures: zipcode, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, area_land_miles, area_water_miles, latitude, longitude, state_code, state_name, city, county, state_fips, zipcode_geom.
country_code_iso: Entity: country codes and related identifiers; Grain: one row per country identified by country_name and code fields; Notable columns/keys/measures: country_name, fips_code, alpha_2_code, alpha_3_code, numeric_code, stanag_code, cctlds, continent_code, continent_name, sub_continent_name.
num_<N>: Entity: single numeric values; Grain: one row per numeric value identified by num; Notable columns/keys/measures: num.
time: Entity: time-of-day breakdowns and derived fields; Grain: one row per time value identified by time; Notable columns/keys/measures: time, hour, minute, second, second_in_day, hour_ampm, is_pm.
date_greg: Entity: Gregorian calendar dates with many derived attributes; Grain: one row per date identified by date/date_int/date_str; Notable columns/keys/measures: date, date_str, date_int, date_dash, date_slash, day, day_abbr, dow_mon17, dow_mon06, dow_sun17, dow_sun06, week_mon, week_sun, week_iso, month, month_abbr, month_first_day, quarter, quarter_first_day, half, half_first_day, year, year_iso, year_first_day.
us_coastline_area: Entity: named U.S. coastline geometries; Grain: one row per coastline feature identified by name; Notable columns/keys/measures: name, coastline_geom.
us_county_area: Entity: U.S. counties geographic footprints and identifiers; Grain: one row per county identified by geo_id, state_fips_code + county_fips_code; Notable columns/keys/measures: geo_id, state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, aff_geo_code, county_name, legal_area_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, county_geom.
us_csa_area: Holds Combined Statistical Area (CSA) geographic shapes and attributes — one row per CSA (grain: one row per csa_code) with keys/identifiers csa_code, aff_geo_code, geo_code, name, lsad_code and measures area_land_meters, area_water_meters plus geometry csa_geom
